1. Built Scalable Backend Systems for 100K+ Users at VitalHealth Solutions  
As a Backend Engineer at VitalHealth Solutions, I’ve focused on creating robust, high-availability systems that power critical health data workflows. My work has directly supported real-time patient monitoring and analytics tools, ensuring reliability for clinicians and researchers. The last year has been about refining architecture to handle growth while maintaining sub-100ms latency for core API endpoints.  

Context  
Healthtech demands precision, and I’ve spent my career solving complex problems at the intersection of software and healthcare. At VitalHealth, I’ve worked closely with cross-functional teams to design REST APIs that integrate with EHR systems, optimize data pipelines for large-scale patient datasets, and ensure compliance with stringent data security standards. My focus is on building infrastructure that scales with the needs of both users and the business.  

Broader Expertise  
I specialize in Python-based microservices, where I’ve led the development of modular APIs that reduce deployment friction and improve team collaboration. My work with Kubernetes and Docker has streamlined CI/CD pipelines, while PostgreSQL and MongoDB setups ensure flexibility for structured and unstructured health data. I’ve also automated infrastructure provisioning with Terraform, and leveraged Redis for caching to enhance performance. GitHub Actions is a daily tool for maintaining consistent, reliable deployments.  

I’m always eager to connect with fellow engineers, discuss innovative solutions, or explore how we can collectively shape the future of healthtech. Let’s grow together.
